gbm_population_evidence.quote: Participants must have diffuse glioma, WHO grades 2-4, histologically confirmed by certified neuropathologistI.

candidate_evidence.quote: Zotiraciclib will be given orally at the DL1, DL-1, or DL 2 once a day on days 1, 4, 8, 11, 15, 18 of every 28-days cycle (18 cycles total).

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Participants must have recurrent disease, proven histologically or by imaging studies

role_evidence.quote: Phase: PHASE1, PHASE2; allocation: NON_RANDOMIZED; model: PARALLEL
This is a phase I/II study to evaluate the safety and efficacy of zotiraciclib as a single agent in recurrent IDH-mutant gliomas.

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: transcriptional suppression, mitochondrial dysfunction and ATP reduction

source_quote.quote: IDH1 or IDH2 mutation status confirmed by TruSight(TM) Oncology 500 performed in LP, NCI or prior documentation of IDH1 or IDH2 mutation status

flag.reason: IDH-mutant selection is linked to zotiraciclib only by a stated preclinical selective vulnerability; could be argued as a diagnostic criterion.

coder_notes: Trial enrols only IDH1/2-mutant diffuse glioma WHO grades 2-4 and never names glioblastoma in conditions, title, inclusion or arm labels, so not_glioblastoma. Surgical cohort gets one pre-surgery dose then biopsy, but no PK or pharmacodynamic measurement is stated. Matched on the record's statement: 'A selective vulnerability to zotiraciclib as a single agent was demonstrated in the preclinical models of IDH-mutant gliomas'.
